newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money market rate eases to 9.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money market rate eases to 9.8 percent.

text.p: Croatian money market eased to 9.8 from 11.2 percent on Tuesday as most deals were made at a lower call money rate, dealers said.
Total settlements doubled to 77.3 million, against the 85 million kuna supply.
Dealers said 52.2 million new borrowings were made by one large bank which needed a short term loan.
Term rates ranged between eight and 13 percent and call money eased to 9.8 from 10.3 percent.
The overnight trade of 80 million kuna consisted of a single loan that went to one bank's mandatory reserves.
The central bank's kuna midrates firmed to 5.3361 against the dollar and eased to 3.5698 against the mark. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
